text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is finally the day of Haru Urara's
debut
race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Urara's debut! ♪ Urara's debut! ♪ It's my
debut!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm actually debuting! Me! It's
so cool!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Having a debut means I get to run a lot!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And I love to run! So I'm super-duper happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And guess what! I feel like I've gotten
stronger
than I was before!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I always win in our little contests after
all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If the results of our contests boosted her

confidence, then I guess all those days
of
soreness were worth it.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why today, I'm gonna get first, for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm definitely gonna be number
one! Here I
go!
